summary: Tested refactored TradingJournal and JournalAIAssistant components after major file size reduction. All 8 journal tabs and AI Assistant features verified working correctly via Playwright UI testing.

Dashboard shows Best Trade, Worst Trade, Most Traded sections
Dashboard displays Win Streak, Loss Streak, Avg R:R, Sharpe Ratio cards
Portfolio Value tab loads correctly (shows connect wallet message without wallet)
Import tab loads DetectedTrades component
Trades tab shows TradesList with filter buttons (all/open/closed) - all filters clickable
Exit Simulator tab loads with input parameters (tokens, entry price, volatility, drift, days, simulations, tax rate)
Exit Simulator has 'Run Simulation' button properly positioned
Achievements tab displays properly (shows connect wallet message without wallet)
Watchlist tab loads with proper UI elements (shows connect wallet message without wallet)
Backup tab shows CloudBackup component with create backup functionality (requires wallet)
AI Assistant visible with 'Bullpug AI' branding and LIVE indicator
AI Assistant shows Top Picks section without wallet connection
Top Picks displays SAFER PICKS section with coin cards (USD1, PYUSD, BAN, ARC, etc.)
Coin cards show symbol, platform, price, 24h change percentage
Star buttons (add to watchlist) present on coin cards
Trade/Find external links present on coin cards

Refresh button for Top Picks working
Log Trade button opens TradeForm modal

CSV and PDF export buttons present in header
Tab navigation works correctly between all 8 tabs
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent refactoring - TradingJournal.js reduced from ~1460 lines to 462 lines (68% reduction)
JournalAIAssistant.js reduced from 1002 lines to 334 lines (67% reduction)
All extracted components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Components properly use centralized index.js for clean exports
API calls use environment variable (process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) correctly
Good separation of concerns - each component has single responsibility
